title: True W(3,2) globally coherent B/A joints positive despite zero point-root Fréchet floors
statement: In genuine W(3,2) with 15 original points, 15 lines and 45 original incidence IDs, under documented fully coherent global K6 injections S68 and S72, the true source-only U_p has exactly 111132 original incidence sixsets for each of all 15 original point roots p. All 15 point-root marginal-only Fréchet lower bounds vanish, yet the ACTUAL jointly classified positive original B(point)/A(line) sixset counts for the complete injected maps are respectively 44 (S68) and 36 (S72). These are finite positive-joint versus zero relaxed-certificate witnesses; no infinite low-S family.

quantifiers.domain: single finite original W(3,2) source geometry; NOT an all-h assertion
fully globally injected original point and line K6 edge assignments frozen as S68 and S72 fixtures
all 15 genuine original source point roots, checked with original six-incidence positional classifier

external_dependencies: Frozen genuine W(3,2) source model, S68/S72 global original injections and pinned historical seven-GF5 original positional classifier.
Independent source-only U_p enumeration compared with true two-sided original ID join; original PR479 Python tests document replay command.
limitations: Positive finite joint intersections do NOT prove a positive universal minimax over all W(3,2^h).
The finite W(3,2) result is not a counterfamily to the all-h root bound or a proof of root Branch B.
The source universe U_p=111132 is a genuine W(3,2) exact count, not the lower estimate M_p=58320.
falsification_boundary: Use both complete globally coherent original global injections and exactly 45 genuine W(3,2) incident source pairs; independently enumerate the actual six-ID B/A joint rather than artificial coordinate-only six-cycles.
